value.rationale: The unit-inverse graph is a canonical Fourier/Kloosterman surface over residue rings. Nilpotent depth creates a genuinely new valuation-dependent discriminant and a singular square-root collision fiber absent over fields. The theorem gives exact support growth and additive energies for all odd prime-power rings, and an explicit route to composite moduli; these are natural invariants used in additive combinatorics and restriction theory, not an arbitrary finite slice.
